listing.tagline: A DeLM implementation built on Claude Code Kanban
listing.description: A DeLM implementation built on Claude Code Kanban. A supervisor and its workers run as Claude Code sessions on the Kanban board, share a task queue and a log of findings, and the app shows each swarm's tasks, claims and published changes. /swarm start refuses when the Kanban CLI does not run.

screenshots.alt: The Swarm timeline: three workers' claimed tasks over one hour, with findings, publications, applies, lost claims, a released task and a stopped worker
Swarm in the hub: the supervisor and two workers grouped in the Kanban sidebar, the task cards with the owner of each, and the Swarm timeline in a pane beside the board
The Swarm summary: the goal, the outcome and delivered files, a change request, the three workers and the items that need a look
The Swarm changes view: who applied whose work, the files each worker touched, and the publications

listing.author: NikiforovAll
